case_title: NIMER ANTON MASSIS VS. AYMAN A. NESHEIWAT

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $6,000.00 FILED BY MASSIS, NIMER ANTON AS TO DEFENDANT NESHEIWAT, AYMAN A. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-26-2016 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF MASSIS, NIMER ANTON AS TO DEFENDANT NESHEIWAT, AYMAN A.
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - SIGNED SERVED JUL-02-2016, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT NESHEIWAT, AYMAN A.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-26-2016 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO OCT-19-2016 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF NIMER ANTON MASSIS & DEFENDANT AYMAN A. NESHEIWAT. INVALID PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. DEFENDANT DID NOT SIGN THE CERTIFIED MAIL RECEIPT, AND HE (MR. NESHEIWAT) WAS UNWILLING TO WAIVE SERVICE OF PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM AT TODAY'S HEARING. PLAINTIFF'S ASSOCIATE PERSONALLY SERVED DEFENDANT AYMAN A. NESHEIWAT WITH PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM IN THE HALLWAY OUTSIDE DEPARTMENT 506 IMMEDIATELY FOLLOWING TODAY'S PROCEEDINGS. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY. NOT REPORTED. (D506).

PROOF OF SERVICE OF SC-100 PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM AND ORDER TO GO TO SMALL CLAIMS COURT: NO FEE FOR SERVICE LISTED FILED BY PLAINTIFF MASSIS, NIMER ANTON SERVED AUG-26-2016, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT NESHEIWAT, AYMAN A.

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF OCT-19-2016 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF OCT-19-2016 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF NIMER ANTON MASSIS. APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT AYMAN A. NESHEIWAT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: S. LE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-19-2016 - JUDGMENT. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: S. LE. NOT REPORTED. (506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MASSIS, NIMER ANTON IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT NESHEIWAT, AYMAN A. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT) STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
